freeze_note: All inputs of this experiment live in this file. Its sha256 is pinned in run_jev_live_systemone_check.py. Any change after the first live run must become jev-live-systemone-check-v2.

pricing.note: The response carries token usage only; cost is computed client-side from usage and this assumed price.

design.note: Thresholds apply to protocol validity only. Choice accuracy, success rate, latency and cost are reported descriptively with no pass/fail threshold.

prompts.action_instructions: You are the action selector in a software workflow. Choose the single best next action toward the stated goal given the current state. Respect prerequisites: an action whose prerequisites are not met will fail. Choose 'abstain' only if no candidate action is applicable or the information given is insufficient.
prompts.verification_instructions: Based only on the current state, are ALL conditions of the stated goal satisfied right now? Answer goal_met only if every condition holds; otherwise answer goal_not_met.

verification_criteria.goal_met: Every condition of the goal is satisfied in the current state.
verification_criteria.goal_not_met: At least one condition of the goal is not yet satisfied.

prompts.abstain_description: No candidate is applicable, or the information is insufficient to choose.
